headline: Mitsui Fudosan says an intruder got into its Mitsui Shopping Park app and data on 3.1 million members leaked; the app is still off.
summary: New incident page. The companies' own notices of Nov 19 (s001) and Nov 26 (s002) state unauthorized access by a third party to the Mitsui Shopping Park app, found Nov 18, the app stopped the same day, and data on about 3,119,000 point-card members leaked (member number, name, date of birth, address, email, phone, gender; no card data or passwords). The route and method are identified but not disclosed; no misuse of app payments or points found so far; preliminary report to the Personal Information Protection Commission. Covered by NHK (s006), ITmedia (s004) and Business+IT (s005). Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated; incident_type breach; service down, resting on c006 (no restart notice on the companies' notices list, s003, at 9:29 PM ET). Size Large. Not a supplier breach: the app is the companies' own. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit could not be read; no outlet reports a claim by any group. Privacy check done: no staff, reporters or contact details named.
